entities.summary: Guadalupe Sabio Buzo is a Spanish scientist and Professor at the Spanish National Cardiovascular Research Centre, which is part of the Carlos III Health Institute. Her research focuses on stress-activated kinases and the development of diseases associated with obesity. She was awarded the Princess of Girona Foundation Scientist Prize in 2012 and selected as one of the Top 100 Women Leaders in Spain in 2017. Guadalupe Sabio was a naturalists & biologists from Badajoz (b. 1977-06-04, Badajoz). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
